name: Sin City Chess
notes: Official Club of the Sin City Chess Discord Community server! (Join the Discord here ➡︎ Join Sin City Chess Community Discord Server Now! ) Why join Sin City Chess? We embrace inclusion, equality, community, and safety of our members. Everyone is welcome without exception. Age limits may apply to some Discord activities/events for obvious reasons(i.e. - IRL gatherings or Discord text/voice channels may have age restrictions for safety of younger members) Find out where chess players are getting together in Las Vegas and your area(in the US) to play live casual games over the board. Our goal is to grow the IRL(in real life) chess community in the US. Sin City Chess Club members(on Chess.com) who also Join the Discord(see link above) will be invited to monthly cash prize tournaments with no entry fee! Along with other perks that go along with being a part of the Sin City Chess Discord Community like: access to voice channels where you can play your favorite chess mode, blitz/bullet/rapid, etc., virtually in one of our 'Playrooms' with your opponent, just as though you were sitting across the table from them! receive invites to other live events in and outside of the Las Vegas community You are joining at the ground level as we are a small new community so you will be one of the original members. We will at some point be the largest IRL chess conglomerate We look forward to you joining and meeting you for some games!

name: Yelm Chess Club
notes: Yelm Chess Club, encourages players of all skill levels to come together and have fun playing chess. Yelm Chess Club offers Youth Specific days and camps to support families while learning to play chess and having fun while building up chess skills. Through the Scouts BSA Chess Merit Badge Program, Yelm Chess Club promotes and support Chess Merit Badge counselors to hold educational youth program. All ages are welcome to meet in person through partnerships with the Nisqually Moose Lodge located in Yelm WA to increase awareness of the value of chess. Depending on the interests and needs of Yelm Chess Club we will offer additional online and in-person events for youth and families, as well as separate events for our adult members.

name: Chess Club at MNSU
notes: The Chess Club at MNSU provides students with a social, informational, instructional, and competitive place for chess. The club offers casual play, tournaments, and instructions on openings, middlegames, tactics, and endgames for players of all levels. The Chess Club aims to connect people through chess, provide possibilities for chess improvement, generate passion for the game, and create enjoyment. Students and non-students (e.g., community members, faculties, and staffs) are welcome at the club. We are located in Mankato, Minnesota.

name: New Boston Chess Club
notes: Welcome to the New Boston Chess Club! We are a local club dedicated to promoting the game of chess in our community. Whether you are an experienced player or just starting out, our club offers a welcoming and inclusive space for all. We offer free play to anyone who wants to come and enjoy the game, regardless of their skill level. Our club is a great place to connect with others who share your passion for chess, and to develop your skills through friendly competition and practice. As a club, we are committed to promoting the values of respect, sportsmanship, and fair play both on and off the board. We believe that chess is not just a game, but a valuable tool for developing critical thinking skills and fostering a sense of community. Join us at the New Boston Chess Club and discover the joy of chess!
